name: Wacky Monsters
source:
Mia’s thirteen, lonely, and tired of being ignored by everyone around her. Then she meets Twunvee, a monster who doesn’t just listen – he understands. 

But friendship with something from below always has a cost.

[From [url=https://mareincognitum.itch.io/wacky-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米娅十三岁，孤独，厌倦了被周围的人忽视。然后她遇到了Twunvee，一个不只是倾听的怪物，他理解。

但与下层人士的友谊总是要付出代价的。

[来自[url=https://mareincognitum.itch.io/wacky-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
